title.zh: 存款保险与保单持有人保障计划（存款保险与保单持有人保障基金机构的指定）公告 2011
title.en: Deposit Insurance and Policy Owners’ Protection Schemes (Designation of Deposit Insurance and Policy Owners’ Protection Fund Agency) Notification 2011

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Deposit Insurance and Policy Owners’ Protection Schemes (Designation of Deposit Insurance and Policy Owners’ Protection Fund Agency) Notification 2011 and shall come into operation on 1st May 2011.

heading.en: Designation of deposit insurance and policy owners’ protection fund agency

text.en: 2. Singapore Deposit Insurance Corporation Limited, a company incorporated in Singapore, is designated as the deposit insurance and policy owners’ protection fund agency for the purposes of the Act.
